notes: § 1401 makes the authentication defined in § 1400 mandatory. § 1400 defines authentication; § 1401 requires it.
§ 1402 addresses authentication of altered writings — a specialized application of the § 1401 requirement.
§ 1410 opens the means of authentication; §§ 1411-1421 enumerate specific means. § 1401 requires authentication; §§ 1410-1421 provide the how.
§§ 1450-1454 provide self-authentication categories — writings that satisfy § 1401's requirement without extrinsic evidence.
